"""v63 一次性独立核验：只读来源与既有结果，不运行 LP、构建或原分析器。"""
import gzip, hashlib, json, math, re, runpy, struct, sys, time, zipfile
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
from fractions import Fraction as F
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
WORK = ROOT / ".tools/v63-diagnostic-final"
PLAN_SHA = "f23be965cc316b4aafce25d435314e3280c5abaf7dce6d9779de5f359b4b738c"
OUT = DATA / "v63-verification.json"
checks, hashes = 0, {}
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import compare_lp

def ck(ok, label):
    global checks
    if not ok: raise AssertionError(label)
    checks += 1

def pairs(items):
    out = {}
    for key, value in items:
        if key in out: raise ValueError("重复 JSON 字段")
        out[key] = value
    return out

def parse(text):
    def floating(value):
        result = float(value)
        if not math.isfinite(result): raise ValueError("JSON浮点溢出")
        return result
    return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_float=floating,
        parse_constant=lambda x: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(x)))

def read(path): return parse(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
def sha(path):
    path = str(Path(path).resolve())
    if path not in hashes: hashes[path] = hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return hashes[path]

def eq(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, dict) and isinstance(b, dict): return a.keys() == b.keys() and all(eq(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a, list) and isinstance(b, list): return len(a) == len(b) and all(eq(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
    return type(a) is type(b) and a == b if type(a) is bool or type(b) is bool else a == b

def integer(x): return type(x) is int and 0 <= x <= 9223372036854775807
def finite(x): return type(x) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(x)
def hx(text):
    m = re.fullmatch(r"([+-]?)0x([0-9a-f]+)(?:\.([0-9a-f]*))?p([+-]?\d+)", text.lower())
    ck(m is not None and len(text) < 256, "宽hex格式")
    sign, whole, tail, exponent = m.groups(); tail = tail or ""
    shift = int(exponent) - 4 * len(tail); ck(abs(shift) <= 65536, "宽hex指数")
    numerator = int(whole + tail, 16) * (-1 if sign == "-" else 1)
    return F(numerator << shift) if shift >= 0 else F(numerator, 1 << -shift)

def packed(value, expected):
    ck(F(int(value["numerator"]), int(value["denominator"])) == expected, "分数值")
    ck(value["sign"] == (expected > 0) - (expected < 0), "分数符号")
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 80
        ck(value["decimal80"] == str(Decimal(expected.numerator) / Decimal(expected.denominator)), "分数十进制展示")

def command(executable, model, plan):
    out = [str(executable), "solve", model["input"], "--backend", "ipm", "--time-limit", str(plan["time_limit"]),
           "--threads", str(plan["threads"]), "--seed", str(plan["seed"]), "--iteration-limit", str(plan["max_iterations"]),
           "--scaling-passes", str(plan["scaling_passes"]), "--ipm-method", plan["method"],
           "--ipm-linear-accuracy", plan["linear_accuracy"], "--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod"]
    for key, value in plan["shared_ipm"].items(): out += ["--ipm-" + key, value]
    return out


COUNT_NAMES = ("completed_iterations", "factorizations", "refinements", "constant_solves", "direction_solves",
    "constant_repairs", "constant_repair_successes", "extended_krylov_attempts", "extended_krylov_successes",
    "scalar_checks", "scalar_rejections")
ARRAY_NAMES = ("starts", "rows", "values", "costs", "rhs", "x", "s", "z", "diagonal_h", "regularized_h",
    "inequality", "direction_rhs", "h", "primal_residual", "dual_residual")


def vector_record(record, values):
    argmax = max(range(len(values)), key=lambda i: abs(values[i])) if values else None
    selected = values[argmax] if argmax is not None else F(0)
    ck(record["argmax"] == argmax, "向量最坏坐标")
    packed(record["infinity"], abs(selected)); packed(record["signed_at_argmax"], selected)


def residual_record(record, upper, lower, tolerances):
    vector_record(record["upper"], upper); vector_record(record["lower"], lower)
    norms = [max(map(abs, values), default=F(0)) for values in (upper, lower)]
    for key, value in zip(("global_norm", "recomputed_global_tolerance", "recomputed_upper_tolerance",
            "recomputed_lower_tolerance", "global_ratio", "upper_ratio", "lower_ratio"),
            (max(norms), *tolerances, max(norms)/tolerances[0], norms[0]/tolerances[1], norms[1]/tolerances[2])):
        packed(record[key], value)
    ck(record["exact_global_satisfied"] is (max(norms) <= tolerances[0]) and
        record["exact_blocks_satisfied"] is (norms[0] <= tolerances[1] and norms[1] <= tolerances[2]), "精确残差门槛")


def physical(arrays, point, ratio):
    c, b, h, g = ([F(value) for value in arrays[key]] for key in ("costs", "rhs", "diagonal_h", "values"))
    n, m = len(c), len(b)
    rx = c.copy(); rz = [-h[i]*point[n+i]-b[i] for i in range(m)]
    for col in range(n):
        for offset in range(arrays["starts"][col], arrays["starts"][col+1]):
            row = arrays["rows"][offset]
            rx[col] += g[offset]*point[n+row]
            rz[row] += g[offset]*point[col]
    dot = sum((a*x for a,x in zip(c+b,point)), F(0))
    energy = sum((h[i]*point[n+i]**2 for i in range(m)), F(0))
    up = sum((x*r for x,r in zip(point[:n],rx)), F(0))
    low = -sum((z*r for z,r in zip(point[n:],rz)), F(0))
    chi = up+low; denominator=ratio-dot; positive=ratio+energy
    ck(denominator == positive-chi and chi == dot+energy, "独立D=E-chi恒等式")
    return rx, rz, dict(ratio=ratio, dot_v=dot, denominator=denominator, energy=energy, positive_energy=positive,
        defect=chi, upper_projection=up, lower_projection=low, identity_error=F(0),
        defect_over_positive_energy=chi/positive, denominator_over_positive_energy=denominator/positive,
        )


def direction_record(record, arrays, point, ratio, raw, tolerances):
    rx, rz, quantities = physical(arrays, point, ratio)
    classification = "actual_scalar_unavailable"
    if raw is not None:
        rv, rd = hx(raw["dot_v"]), hx(raw["denominator"])
        quantities.update(raw_dot_v=rv, raw_denominator=rd, dot_v_rounding=rv-quantities["dot_v"],
            ratio_and_subtraction_rounding=rd-(ratio-rv), total_scalar_rounding=rd-quantities["denominator"])
        ck(quantities["total_scalar_rounding"] == quantities["ratio_and_subtraction_rounding"]-
            quantities["dot_v_rounding"], "独立标量舍入恒等式")
        classification = "positive_actual_and_exact_denominator" if rd > 0 and quantities["denominator"] > 0 else \
            "nonpositive_actual_and_exact_denominator" if rd <= 0 and quantities["denominator"] <= 0 else \
            "actual_and_exact_denominator_signs_differ"
    ck(record["identity_exact"] is True and record["classification"] == classification and
        set(record["scalars"]) == set(quantities), "方向数学字段与分类")
    for key, value in quantities.items(): packed(record["scalars"][key], value)
    residual_record(record["residual"], rx, rz, tolerances)
    terms = [("upper", i, point[i]*value) for i, value in enumerate(rx)]
    terms += [("lower", i, -point[len(rx)+i]*value) for i, value in enumerate(rz)]
    expected = sorted(terms, key=lambda item: abs(item[2]), reverse=True)[:10]
    ck(len(record["largest_signed_projection_terms"]) == len(expected), "投影项数量")
    for (block, index, value), item in zip(expected, record["largest_signed_projection_terms"]):
        ck(item["block"] == block and item["index"] == index, "最坏投影项位置")
        packed(item["value"], value)
    return rx, rz


def scalar_record(record, raw):
    nonfinite = raw in ("nan", "inf", "-inf")
    ck(record["finite"] is not nonfinite and record["kind"] == (raw if nonfinite else "finite"), "实际scalar有限性")
    if nonfinite: ck(record["exact"] is None, "非有限不能伪造Fraction")
    else: packed(record["exact"], hx(raw))


def step_record(step, result, dimension, previous):
    for key in ("kind", "ir_iteration", "restart", "column"):
        ck(eq(step[key], result[key]), "阶段索引来源")
    ck(all(type(step[key]) is int for key in ("ir_iteration", "restart", "column")), "阶段位置严格整数")
    if step["kind"] == "ir_candidate":
        ck(step["restart"] == step["column"] == -1 and 0 <= step["ir_iteration"] <= 2, "IR位置")
        ck(previous is None and step["ir_iteration"] == 0 or previous is not None and
            previous["kind"] == "ir_candidate" and step["ir_iteration"] == previous["ir_iteration"]+1, "IR从0依次推进")
    else:
        ck(step["kind"] == "krylov_candidate" and step["ir_iteration"] == -1 and
            0 <= step["restart"] < 3 and 1 <= step["column"] <= min(32,dimension), "Krylov位置预算")
        ck(previous is not None, "Krylov之前须有IR候选")
        if previous["kind"] == "krylov_candidate":
            ck((step["restart"],step["column"]) > (previous["restart"],previous["column"]), "Krylov候选单调前进")
    norm, tol = hx(step["global_norm"]), hx(step["global_tolerance"])
    norms, tols = [hx(x) for x in step["block_norms"]], [hx(x) for x in step["block_tolerances"]]
    ck(len(norms) == len(tols) == 2 and all(x >= 0 for x in norms) and all(x > 0 for x in tols)
        and norm == max(norms) and tol > 0, "实际范数与门槛")
    global_pass, blocks_pass = norm <= tol, all(a <= b for a,b in zip(norms,tols))
    packed(result["global_ratio"],norm/tol)
    for record, value in zip(result["block_ratios"], (a/b for a,b in zip(norms,tols))): packed(record,value)
    ck(result["global_passed"] is global_pass and result["blocks_passed"] is blocks_pass, "独立阶段残差分类")
    for key in ("scalar_values_available", "scalar_return_available", "scalar_accounted"):
        ck(type(step[key]) is bool, "应用阶段布尔")
    available, returned, accounted = (step[key] for key in ("scalar_values_available", "scalar_return_available", "scalar_accounted"))
    ck(not (available or returned or accounted) or global_pass and blocks_pass, "只有K0通过才实际检查D")
    ck(not returned or available, "返回必须已有标量值")
    ck(not accounted or returned, "记账必须在返回之后")
    if available:
        ck(isinstance(result["scalar_values"],dict), "实际标量记录")
        for key in ("dot_v", "denominator"): scalar_record(result["scalar_values"][key],step[key])
    else:
        ck(result["scalar_values"] is None and step["dot_v"] is step["denominator"] is None, "未计算标量不得造值")
    accepted = None
    if returned:
        ck(type(step["scalar_accepted"]) is bool, "实际返回是bool")
        accepted = step["denominator"] not in ("nan","inf","-inf") and hx(step["denominator"]) > 0
        ck(step["scalar_accepted"] is accepted, "实际D与谓词返回一致")
    else: ck(step["scalar_accepted"] is None, "未返回accepted必须null")
    ck(result["scalar_return_available"] is returned and result["scalar_accepted"] is accepted and
        result["scalar_accounted"] is accounted, "应用阶段摘要")
    classification = ("global_and_block_residual_failed" if not global_pass and not blocks_pass else
        "global_residual_failed" if not global_pass else "block_residual_failed" if not blocks_pass else
        "residual_passed_scalar_result_unavailable" if not returned else
        "residual_and_scalar_passed" if accepted else "residual_passed_scalar_rejected")
    ck(result["classification"] == classification, "独立阶段类别")
    return returned, accounted and accepted is False


def exact_event(meta, blob, result):
    for key in ("index","repair_ordinal","iteration","phase","regularization_level","before_counts","after_counts",
            "committed","candidate_available","after_scalar_available","failure","linear_exit","linear_position","cycles"):
        ck(eq(meta[key],result[key]), "分析事件元数据")
    for which in ("before_counts","after_counts"):
        values=meta[which]
        ck(set(values)==set(COUNT_NAMES) and all(integer(v) for v in values.values()), "事件计数严格整数")
        ck(values["constant_repair_successes"] <= values["constant_repairs"] and
            values["extended_krylov_successes"] <= values["extended_krylov_attempts"] and
            values["scalar_rejections"] <= values["scalar_checks"], "事件计数关系")
    delta={key:meta["after_counts"][key]-meta["before_counts"][key] for key in COUNT_NAMES}
    ck(all(v>=0 for v in delta.values()) and delta==result["work_delta"], "事件账本不倒退且与摘要相同")
    arrays={}
    ck(tuple(field["name"] for field in meta["arrays"]) == ARRAY_NAMES, "完整原矩阵数组")
    for descriptor in meta["arrays"]:
        code={"i64_le":"q","f64_le":"d","u8":"B"}[descriptor["dtype"]]
        values=list(struct.unpack_from("<"+str(descriptor["count"])+code,blob,descriptor["offset"]))
        ck(code!="d" or all(math.isfinite(x) for x in values), "实际数组有限")
        arrays[descriptor["name"]]=values
    n,m=len(arrays["costs"]),len(arrays["rhs"]); dimension=n+m
    starts,rows,values=arrays["starts"],arrays["rows"],arrays["values"]
    ck(len(starts)==n+1 and starts[0]==0 and starts[-1]==len(rows)==len(values) and
        all(0<=a<=b for a,b in zip(starts,starts[1:])) and all(0<=r<m for r in rows), "独立CSC结构")
    ck(all(all(rows[k]<rows[k+1] for k in range(starts[j],starts[j+1]-1)) for j in range(n)), "CSC列内有序无重复")
    for key,size in (("x",n),("s",m),("z",m),("diagonal_h",m),("regularized_h",m),("inequality",m),
            ("direction_rhs",dimension),("h",m),("primal_residual",m),("dual_residual",n)):
        ck(len(arrays[key])==size, "原工作数组维数")
    ck(all(x>=0 for x in arrays["diagonal_h"]), "实际H非负")
    for key in ("last_linear_available","linear_rhs_available","committed","candidate_available","after_scalar_available"):
        ck(type(meta[key]) is bool, "事件可用性布尔")
    steps=meta["small_events"]
    ck(meta["linear_exit"] in ("not_started", "searching", "ir_return", "krylov_return", "krylov_exhausted",
        "invalid_initial_residual", "degenerate_subspace", "exception", "exception_after_acceptance"), "真实退出枚举")
    position = meta["linear_position"]
    ck(set(position) == {"ir_iteration", "restart", "column"} and
        all(type(value) is int for value in position.values()), "退出位置类型")
    ck(-1 <= position["ir_iteration"] <= 2 and -1 <= position["restart"] <= 2 and
        -1 <= position["column"] <= min(32, dimension), "退出位置范围")
    ck(len(steps)==meta["step_count"]==meta["step_total"]<=meta["step_capacity"]==256 and meta["step_dropped"]==0,
        "256阶段槽完整无丢失")
    ck(meta["last_candidate_step_index"]==len(steps)-1 and type(meta["last_candidate_step_index"]) is int and
        meta["last_linear_available"] is bool(steps), "末候选真实索引")
    ck(len(result["stage_records"])==len(steps) and result["stage_record_count"]==len(steps) and
        result["stage_record_total"]==len(steps) and result["stage_record_dropped"]==0,"阶段记录完整")
    returned=rejected=0; previous=None; rejected_indices=[]
    for index,(step,record) in enumerate(zip(steps,result["stage_records"])):
        completed,rejection=step_record(step,record,dimension,previous); previous=step
        returned+=completed; rejected+=rejection
        if completed and step["scalar_accepted"] is False: rejected_indices.append(index)
    if meta["linear_exit"] == "not_started":
        ck(not steps and not meta["linear_rhs_available"] and not meta["candidate_available"] and
            position == {"ir_iteration": -1, "restart": -1, "column": -1}, "未启动没有求解候选")
    else: ck(meta["linear_rhs_available"], "启动后已保存常数右端")
    if meta["linear_exit"] in ("ir_return", "krylov_return", "exception_after_acceptance"):
        ck(bool(steps) and steps[-1]["scalar_return_available"] and steps[-1]["scalar_accepted"] and
            position == {key: steps[-1][key] for key in position}, "接受点必须有实际谓词与位置")
    if meta["linear_exit"] == "exception_after_acceptance":
        ck(not meta["candidate_available"] and bool(meta["failure"]), "严格接受后异常尚未返回candidate")
    if meta["candidate_available"]:
        ck(meta["linear_exit"] in ("ir_return", "krylov_return"), "实际返回候选对应接受退出")
    if meta["committed"]:
        ck(meta["candidate_available"] and meta["after_scalar_available"] and not meta["failure"], "提交拥有完整返回与最终标量")
    ck(sum(step["scalar_values_available"] for step in steps) <= delta["scalar_checks"], "已算标量不超生产检查")
    ck(len(meta["cycles"])==3,"三周期记录")
    for index,cycle in enumerate(meta["cycles"]):
        ck(type(cycle["started"]) is bool and type(cycle["ended"]) is bool and
            all(integer(cycle[key]) for key in ("columns_started","columns_completed","remaining_zero_count")),"周期字段类型")
        ck(0<=cycle["remaining_zero_count"]<=cycle["columns_completed"]<=cycle["columns_started"]<=min(32,dimension),"每周期实际列预算")
        ck(cycle["started"] or not cycle["ended"] and cycle["columns_started"]==0,"未开始周期没有工作")
        if cycle["started"] and index: ck(meta["cycles"][index-1]["ended"],"周期依序结束后才重启")
        ck(all(step["column"]<=cycle["columns_completed"] for step in steps
            if step["kind"]=="krylov_candidate" and step["restart"]==index),"候选列未超出完成列数")
    if meta["linear_exit"] == "krylov_exhausted":
        ck(all(cycle["started"] and cycle["ended"] for cycle in meta["cycles"]) and
            not meta["candidate_available"], "耗尽三周期且没有返回候选")
    ir=max((step["ir_iteration"] for step in steps if step["kind"]=="ir_candidate"),default=None)
    started=sum(c["columns_started"] for c in meta["cycles"]); completed=sum(c["columns_completed"] for c in meta["cycles"])
    expected_refine=None if ir is None else ir+completed
    complete=meta["linear_exit"] in ("ir_return","krylov_return","krylov_exhausted","invalid_initial_residual")
    if complete: ck(expected_refine==delta["refinements"] and returned==delta["scalar_checks"] and rejected==delta["scalar_rejections"],"实际搜索账本闭合")
    ck(returned<=delta["scalar_checks"] and rejected<=delta["scalar_rejections"],"部分记录不超计")
    accounting=result["work_accounting"]
    for key,value in dict(ir_corrections_before_last_recorded_ir_candidate=ir,arnoldi_columns_started=started,
            arnoldi_columns_completed=completed,sum_recorded_ir_and_completed_columns=expected_refine,
            actual_refinement_delta=delta["refinements"],complete_search_accounting=complete,
            refinement_delta_matches=expected_refine==delta["refinements"],recorded_scalar_returns=returned,
            recorded_accounted_rejections=rejected,scalar_counter_delta_matches=returned==delta["scalar_checks"] and rejected==delta["scalar_rejections"]).items():
        ck(eq(accounting[key],value),"独立搜索账本摘要")
    ck([row["step_index"] for row in result["rejected_candidates"]]==rejected_indices,"拒绝候选索引")
    for index,record in zip(rejected_indices,result["rejected_candidates"]):
        ck(eq({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k!="step_index"},result["stage_records"][index]),"拒绝时间线来源")
    if not meta["last_linear_available"]:
        ck(result["last_linear"] is None,"无末候选不造数学结果"); return 0
    point=list(map(hx,meta["wide"]["last_linear_candidate"]))
    stored=list(map(hx,meta["last_linear_residual"])); right=list(map(hx,meta["linear_rhs"]))
    ck(len(point)==len(stored)==len(right)==dimension,"末候选维数")
    ck(right==[-F(x) for x in arrays["costs"]]+[F(x) for x in arrays["rhs"]],"常数右端是原-c,b")
    ck(all(F(float(value))==value for value in stored+right),"保存残差和RHS是binary64精确提升")
    tau,kappa=(hx(meta["scalars"][key]) for key in ("tau","kappa")); ck(tau>0 and kappa>0,"正齐次状态")
    u=list(map(hx,meta["wide"]["u"])); ck(len(u)==dimension,"原方向u维数")
    last=result["last_linear"]; direction=last["direction"]; final_step=steps[-1]
    raw_available=final_step["scalar_values_available"] and all(final_step[key] not in ("nan","inf","-inf") for key in ("dot_v","denominator"))
    tolerances=[F(1e-12+1e-10*max(map(abs,values),default=0.0)) for values in
        (arrays["costs"]+arrays["rhs"],arrays["costs"],arrays["rhs"])]
    rx,rz=direction_record(direction,arrays,point,kappa/tau,final_step if raw_available else None,tolerances)
    for which in ("before", "after"):
        saved=meta["wide"][which+"_v"]
        if saved is None: ck(result[which] is None, "无返回方向不造数学结果")
        else:
            saved=list(map(hx,saved)); ck(len(saved)==dimension,"修复方向维数")
            direction_record(result[which],arrays,saved,kappa/tau,meta[which],tolerances)
    residual_record(last["production_residual"],stored[:n],stored[n:],tolerances)
    ck([hx(final_step["global_tolerance"]),*[hx(x) for x in final_step["block_tolerances"]]]==tolerances,"实际阈值独立重算")
    ck([hx(final_step["global_norm"]),*[hx(x) for x in final_step["block_norms"]]]==
        [max(map(abs,v),default=F(0)) for v in (stored,stored[:n],stored[n:])],"保存残差与实际范数一致")
    error=[observed+actual for observed,actual in zip(stored,rx+rz)]
    for key,values in (("whole",error),("upper",error[:n]),("lower",error[n:])):
        vector_record(last["residual_evaluation_error"][key],values)
    selected=sorted(range(dimension),key=lambda i:abs(error[i]),reverse=True)[:10]
    entries=last["residual_evaluation_error"]["largest_entries"]
    ck([item["index"] for item in entries]==selected,"残差舍入误差最坏十坐标")
    for index,item in zip(selected,entries):
        ck(item["block"]==("upper" if index<n else "lower"),"残差误差块")
        for key,value in (("production",stored[index]),("exact",-(rx+rz)[index]),("error",error[index])): packed(item[key],value)
    ck(last["candidate_step_index"]==len(steps)-1 and eq(last["last_step"],result["stage_records"][-1]) and
        last["actual_scalar_evaluated"] is final_step["scalar_values_available"] and
        last["repair_candidate_available"] is meta["candidate_available"] and last["committed"] is meta["committed"] and
        last["captured_norms_and_thresholds_match"] is True,"末候选来源与可用性")
